PUT /api/profiles/{id} now replaces an owned active profile’s opaque content with expected-revision concurrency. Current account-wide or same-profile selected access is required; hidden targets return404, invalid access403, stale edits409. The transaction locks account/session/profile in order and rechecks permissions with current PostgreSQL statement time, preventing expired access from writing after lock waits.

Success returns only public profile ID, new revision, synchronization sequence and stored UTC edit time. Timestamp normalization happens before binding, including pre2000 submicrosecond dates. Ownership, key wrappers, scoped verifiers and associations remain unchanged. Changed envelopes must use fresh current-visible salt/nonce and the current content epoch. Complete native rotation now validates an existing signed wrapper revision that precedes a later content revision; replacement wrappers still bind the new profile revision exactly.

Covers issue #13 / FR-PR-04, BR03/04 and main/AF01–05. Adds58 persistence/rotation,28 command and61 HTTP cases. Fresh full unfiltered solution: **1,711 passed, zero failures/skips;97.7% production line coverage,89.4% branch coverage**. Helpers23, specification consistency, actual OpenAPI generation/drift and diff checks pass. One ordinary final review completed. Its Important timestamp boundary was reproduced through real HTTP: accepted writes produced later GET/list503. One correction pass now rejects values that normalize to default before either creation or update; six boundary regressions prove400/no mutation and the first full microsecond stays readable. All8 declined scopes have explicit reason/cost rulings. Deferred minors: known global OpenAPI metadata and stale-revision409 after profile-lock session expiry (no mutation/data; final SQL access check remains strict). No second review; required branch-policy/test/docker checks gate the authorized develop merge. No migration or protocol-format change.

Independent security/protocol and real-client approvals remain deferred development-only with the strict release gate unchanged. Historical/cross-device nonce accounting remains a client obligation; selected-session proof/key isolation belongs UC15, change feed UC48, and future resource/sharing flows retain visible-link integration obligations. Known global OpenAPI metadata correction remains tracked before release.

Closes #13.
